info.name: Task57 - Publish Guide API
info.description: Tests POST /guides. Set baseUrl, accessToken, and courseId variables locally. Obtain accessToken by logging in through the existing API; this collection contains no real credentials or token.

exec: pm.test('returns the created guide and course', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.course.id).to.equal(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('courseId'))); pm.expect(body.publisher_name).to.be.a('string'); });

body.raw:
{
  "course_id": {{courseId}},
  "title": "Task57 Postman test guide",
  "academic_year": 2569,
  "semester": 1,
  "exam_period": "midterm",
  "topics": "Postman test topic",
  "exam_format": "mixed",
  "objective_count": 10,
  "subjective_count": 2,
  "additional_advice": null
}

request.description: Set the collection variables locally. Do not save a real token in the shared collection.

exec: pm.test('uses the standard auth error code', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.equal('AUTH_REQUIRED'); });

request.description: Confirms the existing current_user Login dependency protects publishing.

exec: pm.test('returns the standard validation error code', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.equal('INVALID_PARAMETERS'); });

request.description: Confirms whitespace-only required text is rejected and does not create a guide.
